outcome_use: No remaining Track-A continuation-state scientific output or XAI output was used to select these implementation details.
spatial_working_image: Apply the frozen CTC deterministic EXIF correction, RGB conversion, square padding and bicubic resize to obtain a 256x256 RGB image. Compute deletion masks on this exact 256x256 coordinate system before tensor normalization.
deletion_fill: Per-image RGB channel mean of the 256x256 working image, rounded to nearest uint8 channel value; replace all three channels at every selected spatial pixel.
saliency_pixel_order: Sort normalized heatmap values descending; exact saliency ties break by ascending flattened row-major pixel index.
random_control: For each stable_row_id/model_run_id/fraction/control_index, seed NumPy PCG64 from the first 64 bits of SHA256(stable_row_id || '|' || model_run_id || '|' || fraction || '|' || control_index), then sample exactly the deleted_pixel_count distinct row-major spatial indices without replacement.

gradcampp.target_score: pre-softmax logit of the clean top-1 predicted class
gradcampp.formula: standard Grad-CAM++ alpha weighting from first, second and third powers of target-score gradients; ReLU positive gradients and final non-negative map
gradcampp.normalization: bilinear upsample to 256x256, then finite per-map min-max normalization to [0,1]; constant maps are degenerate
gradcampp.batching: one image at a time for attribution to avoid cross-example gradient coupling

cnn_target_resolution: Resolve the last leaf torch.nn.Conv2d whose synthetic-zero 1x3x256x256 forward output is 4D with both spatial dimensions >1. Resolution occurs before any DS-V1-VAL XAI output and the exact module path is fixed across all seeds of that family.
r13_target: blocks.13.norm1 with [B,257,320] -> drop one prefix token -> [B,256,320] -> [B,16,16,320] -> [B,320,16,16]. Fail closed on any contract drift.

randomization_sanity.subset: deterministic 30-image subset of the frozen 240-image XAI sample by SHA256(stable_row_id || '|TRACKA-A1-XAI-RANDOMIZE-V1')
randomization_sanity.target_class: retain each image's original clean top-1 class when recomputing the randomized-head attribution
randomization_sanity.classifier_randomization: deterministically reset only classifier-head modules/parameters, leaving the backbone unchanged, then restore exact original classifier bytes/state before any subsequent analysis
randomization_sanity.comparison: Spearman correlation of flattened normalized original versus randomized-head maps

flip_consistency.subset: deterministic 30-image subset of the frozen 240-image XAI sample by SHA256(stable_row_id || '|TRACKA-A1-XAI-FLIP-V1')
flip_consistency.target_class: retain the original clean top-1 class for the horizontally flipped attribution
flip_consistency.comparison: Spearman correlation of the original normalized map and the horizontally inverse-flipped normalized map from the flipped input

qualitative_panel: Exactly 12 XAI-sample rows by SHA256(stable_row_id || '|TRACKA-A1-XAI-PANEL-V1'); no manual substitution.
selection_role: Supporting trustworthiness evidence only. No XAI scalar enters the Pareto or lexicographic model-selection rule.
